integrity: The general proof is combinatorial, with a primitive integral cube-face boundary relation; independent finite mod-two checks over 364 squared-length triples are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Eight Euclidean vertices of rectangular three-dimensional boxes with arbitrary strictly positive side lengths only; no general parallelepipeds, filled solids, higher-dimensional boxes, or non-Euclidean metrics. Indexed originality comparison does not exclude unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact Vietoris–Rips homotopy and persistence of rectangular-box vertices
